mapper.select: SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsContentlistMapper : 콘텐츠활용신청*/ count(*) FROM AYE100 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '13' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ AND DEL_YN = 'N' /*삭제여부*/

SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsContentlistMapper : 콘텐츠활용신청(조회)*/ BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글번호*/ , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 게시글유형구분코드 */ , TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_DT /*신청일자*/ , C##RG.DEC_B64(WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /*신청자명*/ , INST_NM /*신청기관명*/ , APRV_STTS_SE_CD /*상태*/ , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM AYE100 WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_YN = 'N' /*삭제여부*/ AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '13' /*게시글유형구분코드*/
AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}||'%'
AND INST_NM LIKE '%'||#{INST_NM}||'%'
AND C##RG.DEC_B64(WRTR_NM_ENCPT) LIKE '%' || #{WRTR_NM_ENCPT} || '%'
ORDER BY FRST_REG_DT DESC OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

/* * SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsContentlistMapper : 콘텐츠활용신청(상세) * 2023.06.16 수정 - Jeong.Won.Je */ SELECT A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글고유번호 */ , A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 게시글유형구분코드 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(A.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /* 작성자명암호화 */ --, A.WRTR_NM_ENCPT AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /* 작성자명암호화 */ , A.INST_NM AS INST_NM /* 신청기관명 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(A.EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS EML_ADDR_ENCPT /* 이메일주소암호화 */ --, A.EML_ADDR_ENCPT AS EML_ADDR_ENCPT /* 이메일주소암호화 */ , NVL(C##RG.DEC_B64(A.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT), '-') AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT /* 휴대전화번호암호화 */ --, NVL(A.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT, '-') AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT /* 휴대전화번호암호화 */ , A.INST_TELNO AS INST_TELNO /* 신청기관번호 */ , A.HPGE_LINKA_PRCUSE_DMND_YN AS HPGE_LINKA_PRCUSE_DMND_YN /* 홈페이지링크활용요청여부 */ , A.WEPS_LINKA_PRCUSE_DMND_YN AS WEPS_LINKA_PRCUSE_DMND_YN /* 웹심리검사링크활용요청여부 */ , A.SRVC_DTL_CN AS SRVC_DTL_CN /* 기타 서비스상세내용 */ , A.APRV_STTS_SE_CD AS APRV_STTS_SE_CD /* 승인상태구분코드 */ , A.BBSCTT_CN AS BBSCTT_CN /* 게시글내용 - 요청사유 */ , A.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT /* 최초등록일자 */ , B.RETE_ESNTAL_NO AS RETE_ESNTAL_NO /* 답글고유번호 */ , B.RETE_CN AS RETE_CN /* 답글내용 - 결과안내 */ FROM AYE100 A LEFT OUTER JOIN AYE120 B ON A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD}
